name: Gameyfin
description: Manage your video games. Gameyfin turns your video game files into a beautiful webpage. Everything is stored locally (except videos) so its LAN-friendly as well!

paths.name: Video game library
paths.description: Add as many video game files as you want

paths.name: Database Directory
paths.description: Where Gameyfins database will be stored

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Where Gameyfins media (images) will be stored

paths.name: Plugin Data Directory
paths.description: Where the installed plugins will store their data

paths.name: Logs Directory
paths.description: Where Gameyfins logs will be stored

ports.name: Gameyfin Web UI
ports.description: Port for Gameyfins web UI (if you do not use a reverse proxy)

ports.name: Tracker port for Torrent plugin
ports.description: Set this if you plan to use the Torrent plugin

ports.name: Seed client port for Torrent plugin
ports.description: Set this if you plan to use the Torrent plugin

variables.name: App Key
variables.description: 16, 24 or 32 byte long Base64 encoded string, which can be generated using the following command: openssl rand -base64 32

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: Set this if you are using Gameyfin with a reverse proxy

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: Set this if you want to run Gameyfin with a specific user ID

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Set this if you want to run Gameyfin with a specific group ID
